user.title: Welcome to HomePrep
user.description: HomePrep will guide you through a quick setup so your household profile and first preparedness targets are ready immediately. Everything can be changed later from the HomePrep sidebar panel.

household.title: Household
household.description: Tell HomePrep who and what you are preparing for. Choose Other if HomePrep does not yet include an official profile for your country.

targets.title: Starter targets
targets.description: Choose the {authority} recommendations you want HomePrep to adopt as your first personal targets. These become editable personal targets; the source guidance remains unchanged.

review.title: Ready to prepare
